## Leakage

- Cells the Natural Earth mask keeps but the ABS boundary rejects: **28** (0.45% of agreed land).
- Of those, **21** exceed the P90 wind speed of agreed land (6.41 m/s) — cells that would surface near the top of a shortlist purely through coastline error.
- Cells the Natural Earth mask wrongly drops (ABS-only land): **10**.
- Ocean cells still carry wind values (mean 7.96 m/s vs land mean 5.18 m/s), confirming Task 1's finding that an explicit land mask is mandatory — without one, the shortlist goes offshore regardless of which mask wins.

## Notes

- The ABS outline used here carries the ~50 m server-side generalisation recorded in the download manifest; at 0.05 deg cells the residual boundary error is two orders of magnitude below cell size.
- Neither mask removes inland water bodies; NLUM class 6 (Water) or the DEA Waterbodies polygons cover that exclusion separately.
